answer_2.quote: Our algorithm managed to perfectly map 85% of near analogies and 77.5% of far ones... On larger problems, it achieves 77.8% perfect mappings...

answer_4.quote: We recruited 304 participants using social media... In the closed-world phase, the participants received ten structure mapping problems... Participants were instructed to map each B entity into exactly one T entity... In the open-world phase, participants received five mapped problems... Participants were instructed to fill in the blank with an entity that preserves the analogy.
answer_4.guideline: Participants mapped entities in a closed-world phase and suggested entities in an open-world phase to preserve analogical structure.
